# Iconiq chat effects

Adapted from https://github.com/edwinvakayil/iconiq at 236a851dd5ebb4c3a079d81c4646e19ab57d7574.
MIT © 2024–2026 Edwin Vakayil; see LICENSE.

Source components: registry/ai-input.tsx (SendWave),
registry/thinking-indicator.tsx, registry/streaming-text.tsx.

Native DOM/CSS adapters: ../../iconiq-chat-effects.js,
../../iconiq-chat-effects.css and ../../assistant-text-stream.js.
